cases.raw_question: 퇴직급여가 미리 정해지는 DB와 달리, 근로자가 운용 성과에 따라 받을 금액이 달라지는 쪽은 무엇이며 적립금 선택은 누가 하나요?
reference_expressions: 근로자가 운용 성과에 따라 받을 금액이 달라지는 쪽
cases.trace: Current deterministic entity detection recognises only explicit DB. The direct selector semantically infers DC for benefit determination, but does not recover the independent operation-party request and adds an unsupported DB benefit requirement.
cases.why_not_binding_miss: No separate resolved-DC subject is available before requirement selection in the current path; the first failed boundary is indirect subject detection.

cases.raw_question: 회사 부담금이 매년 임금에 따라 정해져 적립되는 제도는 어느 것이고, 그 계좌 운용방법은 누가 고르나요?
cases.trace: The selector correctly identifies the DC employer-contribution distinction, so it has enough semantic scope for the first factual unit. It omits the second independently asked operation-party unit after the anaphoric phrase '그 계좌'.
cases.why_not_subject_detection_miss: Although the legacy deterministic detector returns no account, the direct selector itself selected a DC-scoped requirement correctly; its proven failure is omission of the second requirement.

cases.raw_question: KR5114420022를 먼저, KR5114450222를 다음으로 언급했을 때 뒤에 적은 상품의 현재 위험등급은 무엇인가요?
cases.trace: The direct requirement is exact. The deterministic resolver extracts both explicit codes but has no ordinal-reference rule to reduce the subject set to the second code.
cases.why_not_requirement_semantic_miss: The requested field is selected exactly; only product identity is over-broad.

decision: P39-3 remains a development regression set. Do not modify the selector or rerun HCX until P39-3B isolates subject/reference resolution from direct requirement selection.
